summary: Frontend UI testing completed for system-wide updates. All 9 features tested and verified working correctly.
passed_tests: BOOKINGS PAGE - Guest Name column NOT shown in list view
BOOKINGS PAGE - Columns shown: Property, Check-in, Check-out, Source, Amount, Status, Actions
BOOKINGS PAGE - Detail modal DOES show guest name (for direct bookings)
BOOKINGS PAGE - Detail modal hides guest name for OTA bookings (empty value)
BOOKINGS PAGE - Edit button (pencil icon) visible for admin on bookings
PROPERTIES PAGE - 'OTA Synced' badge shown for properties with ota_feeds
PROPERTIES PAGE - 'Manual' badge shown for properties without ota_feeds
TASKS PAGE - Task types dropdown includes all defaults (Housekeeping, Maintenance, Check-in, Check-out, Transport, Breakfast, Meal, Excursion)
TASKS PAGE - Services merged into task types dropdown (Deep Cleaning from services shown)
SERVICES PAGE - Predefined service list available (Airport Transfer, Breakfast, Check-in, Check-out, Concierge, Housekeeping, Laundry, Maintenance, Meal, Spa, Transport, Excursion)
SERVICES PAGE - 'Other (Custom)' option available for custom service names
EXPENSES PAGE - Fixed categories: Staff Payment, Insurance, Property Tax, Internet, Rent, Software, Salaries

EXPENSES PAGE - Variable categories include Airbnb-specific: Airbnb Commission, OTA Fees, Cleaning, Pool Maintenance, Gardening, Guest Amenities, Linen, Supplies, Repairs, Utilities, Maintenance, Other
INVITE PAGE - Owner dropdown shows property owners from existing properties
INVITE PAGE - Auto-select properties when owner is picked from dropdown

bookings_guest_name_hidden_list.details: Guest Name column removed from list view. Table headers: Property, Check-in, Check-out, Source, Amount, Status, Actions

bookings_guest_name_visible_detail.details: Guest name visible in booking detail modal for direct bookings (e.g., Alice Johnson). OTA bookings don't show guest name field since it's empty.

bookings_edit_button.details: Pencil icon (Edit button) visible in Actions column for admin users, both in list and detail modal

properties_ota_manual_badges.details: PropertyCard shows 'OTA Synced' badge (blue with globe icon) for properties with ota_feeds array, 'Manual' badge (green) for properties without

tasks_service_types_merged.details: Task Type dropdown shows default types (Housekeeping, Maintenance, Check-in, Check-out, Transport, Breakfast, Meal, Excursion) + services from Services page (e.g., Deep Cleaning)

services_predefined_other.details: Service Type dropdown has predefined list + 'Other (Custom)' option for custom service names. No categories - simplified structure.

expenses_expanded_categories.details: Variable expense categories include Airbnb/Villa management specific: Airbnb Commission, OTA Fees, Cleaning, Pool Maintenance, Gardening, Guest Amenities, etc.

invite_auto_select_properties.details: When Owner role is selected and an owner is picked from dropdown, their associated properties are automatically selected in the Assign Properties section

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Bookings.js SectionedBookingList correctly excludes Guest Name from table headers
✅ Bookings.js detail modal shows guest_name conditionally only if present and not empty
✅ Properties.js PropertyCard correctly checks ota_feeds.length for OTA/Manual badge
✅ Tasks.js dynamically builds taskTypes from DEFAULT_TASK_TYPES + services
✅ Expenses.js EXPENSE_CATEGORIES properly split into Fixed and Variable types with Airbnb-specific categories
✅ Invitations.js useEffect auto-selects properties based on owner's email matching property owner_email
seed_data_creation: Created 2 properties (Beach Villa OTA with ota_feeds, Downtown Apartment Manual without), 2 bookings (1 OTA, 1 direct), 1 staff (housekeeper), 1 service (Deep Cleaning), 1 expense (airbnb_commission)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 verified all frontend UI updates: (1) Bookings list hides Guest Name, detail modal shows it (2) Properties show OTA Synced/Manual badges (3) Tasks merge services into task types (4) Services have predefined list + Other option (5) Expenses have expanded Airbnb-specific categories (6) Invite auto-selects properties for owners. All features working correctly.
